transliteration: dvirāmuṣyāyaṇā dadyur dvābhyāṃ piṇḍodake pṛthak | rikthād ardhāṃśam ādadyur bījikṣetrikayos tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who twice invoke the name of Amushya shall give separately two portions of food and water; likewise, from the proceeds of sale of property inherited or acquired through seeds and land, half shall be taken.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derived from invocation establishes relational dharmic obligation
Causation rooted in repeated invocation necessitates proportional offering
Capacity-based responsibility determined by benefit received from invoked entity
Restoration logic demands redistribution of material gain for energetic balance
Consciousness alignment occurs through reciprocal acknowledgment of invoked presence
executable_legal_axioms: IF invocation_count >= 2 AND invoked_name == 'Amushya' THEN allocate_two_separate_portions(food, water)
IF property_gain_source IN [seed_labor, land_utilization] AND invocation_present == true THEN allocate_half_proceeds(to_invoked_lineage_or_designated_recipient)
IF benefit_received > threshold THEN responsibility_coefficient = 0.5 * benefit_value
IF energetic_debt_detected BETWEEN parties THEN initiate_restorative_transfer(protocol_type: completion_process)
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving claims based on ancestral or spiritual invocation rights, the court must verify frequency and nature of invocation, assess proportionate material benefits derived therefrom, and enforce restorative allocation without punitive measures against either party. Authority lies in documented energetic causality, not historical ownership alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via repeated invocation creating causal link; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as material benefit requiring energetic rebalancing; responsibility aligns with capacity to restore rather than inflict penalty; reality remains non-punitive as imbalance is resolved through conscious completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate_completion_process: ensure delivery of specified food and water portions to designated recipients
Execute_capacity_assessment: determine material gain traceable to invoked lineage or practice
Perform_integrity_reintegration: facilitate voluntary offering of half-proceeds to maintain energetic reciprocity
Deploy_consciousness_audit: monitor ongoing alignment between invocation and reciprocal action
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Invocation binds in dharma, benefit necessitates offering, and restoration prevails over judgment. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator, and reality abides in non-punitivity.
